text:
I found a delay before the project started.

While building a baseline, one contract key date did not add up. The client's own delivery date for a major equipment package was five days before the key date for installing it. The installation needs about a month.

What I did with it:
• Put it in the Basis of Schedule, both dates side by side.
• Stated the date the equipment is actually needed on site.
• Showed that nothing downstream moves, so the issue stays the size it is.

A conflict recorded in the baseline is an early warning. The same conflict found six months later is a dispute.

What do you check in a contract before you build the first activity?

#ProjectControls #Planning #Scheduling #Contracts #EPC #PrimaveraP6
